items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "A band I used to play with,"—Snookums Russell [phonetic], was it, or something like that—he says, "and I want to go over and say hello to the guys."

ctx.x: I think we played Providence and . . . gee, I hadn’t remembered before that I played in Fletcher’s band with Roy Eldridge, but I must have, because I remember that one night we were off, and he said, “Come on, let’s go over to Woonsocket.” He said, “A band I used to play with,”—Snookums Russell [phonetic], was it, or something like that—he says, “and I want to go over and say hello to the guys.” So we went over, and they had this pianist, Teddy Wilson, who just impressed me so greatly. I said, “Gee whiz, he’s a…
venue that was donated, you know. So he didn’t have to help. There was nothing for him to finance.
